changes: Converted from the PDF into structured JSON by Prospero's Dungeon (scripts/srd52_extract); the text is otherwise unchanged apart from the items below.
Removed the publisher's game trademark from one sentence in Playing the Game.

Added fields that are not in the source: ids, parsed numbers (prices in copper, weights, dice, saves, attacks), shop_types, legality, value_cp for magic items (from the Magic Item Rarities and Values table) and wage classes.
Corrected one printing error, listed under corrections.

outcome_mapping.critical_success: natural 20 on an attack roll or a death saving throw
outcome_mapping.critical_failure: natural 1 on an attack roll or a death saving throw

pricing.magic_item_value: value_cp is the rarity value; halved for consumables other than Spell Scroll; a Spell Scroll is worth double its scribing cost. Add the base item cost from equipment for magic armor and weapons.
pricing.wage_classes: economy.wages: unskilled = untrained hireling, skilled = skilled hireling (cp per day).

corrections.why: The minus sign is missing; the modifier is -2 and the dragon has no Int save proficiency.

source_notes.note: The description ends mid-sentence in the source PDF.
Initiative is printed as -2 (13); Dex 6 gives -2 (8).
XP is printed as 8,000; the CR 12 row of the XP table says 8,400. Initiative +7 does not follow from Dex +2 and proficiency +4.
The Sorcerer spell list omits Mind Spike, and the Bard, Sorcerer and Wizard lists omit Phantasmal Force, though those spells name the classes.
